The testbench uses $error, $value$plusargs, #-delays and $random(seed). It assumes the platform runs Icarus in SystemVerilog mode and Verilator with --binary/--timing. Under Verilator the first $error may stop the run before the verdict line prints, which still counts as a failed run.

The formal wrapper module exists only under `ifdef FORMAL`, so lint, simulation and synthesis see only rr_arbiter.
